newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel awards post deal to SIA.
newsitem.headline: SingTel awards post deal to SIA.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) said on Monday it had awarded contracts worth Singapore $4.49 million a year to Singapore Airlines Ltd for the conveyance of airmail.
Singtel, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Singapore Post, also awarded airmail contracts to SIA unit SilkAir, and to 16 other airlines.
The annual value of SilkAir's contract is S$130,200 and the combined value of the contracts awarded to the 16 other airlines is S$1.92 million, SingTel said in a statement.
SIA's ultimate holding company is Temasek Holdings, a substantial shareholder of SingTel, it said.
The contracts are for a period of two years starting April 1, 1997 with an option to extend another year.
